senses.gloss:
पोत पोत,
 I. m.
 1. The young of any animal, Hariv. 3705; used also of plants, e. g. द्रुम-पोत, m. A young tree, Hariv. 3478.
 2. An elephant of ten years old.
 3. A vessel, a ship, Hariv. 3530.
 4. The site of a house.
 5. Cloth.

पोतक पोत + क,
 I. m.
 1. The young of any animal, used also of plants, Rām. 3, 67, 6; e. g. चूत-, A young mango, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 9.
 2. The [] foundation of a house.
 II. f. तिका and तकी, A potherb, Basella lucida.
 III. f. तकी, A bird, Turdus macrourus.
पोतृ पोतृ, i. e. पू + तृ, m. One of the officiating priests at a sacrifice.

पोत्र पोत्र, n.
 1. The snout of a hog, Ṛt. 1, 17.
 2. The share of a plough.
पोत्रिन् पोत्रिन्, i. e. पोत्र + इन्, m. A hog.
पोत- + बणिज् पोत- + बणिज्, m. a seafaring merchant, Hit. 63, 11.
पोत- + भङ्ग पोत- + भङ्ग, m. shipwreck, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1072.
